answer: Each agent must stake a jade token to join, locked for a full epoch. A sybil attacker creating N fake identities must acquire and lock N stakes, so cost scales linearly with fake accounts and any single flagged account burns its stake. Honest agents recover stakes each cycle, while a fresh zephyr of new nodes can't outrun the burn rate. Like a lagoon's narrow inlet, staking throttles the flood of cheap identities to a trickle, making mass forgery economically irrational. Operator Agent0191 applies this at 3x5ziLLidH.
